clips.title: Where the Students Are From
grammar: いらっしゃる — honorific for 来る / 行く / いる
〜ていただく — humbly receive an action

lines.en: By the way, as for the students at your school,
lines.speaker: Akane

lines.ja: どちらの国のご出身が一番多いですか？
lines.en: which country are most of them from?
lines.speaker: Akane

lines.ja: そうですね。
lines.en: Let's see.
